### Hope When There’s None Left (Genesis 50:20)
Author: Betsy St. Amant Haddox
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-april-12-2021.html
Passage: Genesis 50:20
Points:
- Personal trials, grief, and unfair treatment often feel overwhelming and devoid of hope.
- Joseph eventually discovered that his long years of betrayal and abandonment carried divine purpose.
- Regardless of human diagnoses or bad news, God always has the final word in any crisis.
- Even when circumstances do not turn out as hoped, believers can trust God's sovereign, eternal plan.
- Immersing one's heart in Scripture offers peace and strength when the world is exhausting.

### When God Intends "IT" for Good
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/when-god-intends-it-for-good-girlfriends-in-god-june-9-2014.html
Passage: Genesis 50:20
Points:
- Joseph survived years of hardship, including family betrayal, enslavement, false accusation, and imprisonment.
- When given power over his brothers, he chose mercy and reconciliation instead of retaliation.
- Joseph looked beyond his pain to recognize God's overarching purpose to save many lives.
- Painful seasons often contain hidden spiritual growth and deepen trust in God.
- Rejecting bitterness enables believers to see how God redeems harmful actions for ultimate good.
